title: Beef and Leaf Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Chinese-inspired dish featuring beef, leaf, and a hint of lime.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the leaf to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce and lime juice.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the beef is coated in the sauce.
Serve hot and garnish with lime wedges, if desired.
